## Purpose
Accounts, sessions, workspaces, roles and RBAC (`app.auth`), from the store up through the HTTP middleware. It makes no Mistral calls.

## Behaviour pinned down
- **Policy table:**
  - every API route has an access rule; deny is the default, so a new endpoint without a rule answers 403;
  - rules name only known permissions;
  - the policy examples hold;
  - platform administration is admin-only;
  - system roles are ordered by power.
- **Passwords:** the hash round-trips and the password policy is enforced.
- **Workspaces:**
  - a workspace needs a working, unique key;
  - the Default workspace uses the platform key and is protected;
  - rotating a key refuses a key for another Mistral workspace unless confirmed;
  - a disabled workspace has no key;
  - a workspace with members is not deleted.
- **Users and sessions:**
  - a user needs a workspace;
  - invite, then login, then logout;
  - a wrong password locks the account;
  - an unknown email and a wrong password look the same;
  - the per-IP rate limit applies, and successful sign-ins do not use it up (an office behind one address);
  - multiple workspaces and switching between them work;
  - a disabled workspace moves or ends the session;
  - disabling or deleting a user ends their sessions;
  - a user who never signed in is removed outright;
  - a password change ends the other sessions;
  - a reset link sets a new password;
  - custom roles work;
  - the bootstrap admin must change their password;
  - the last admin, and yourself, are protected;
  - the audit log records actions.
- **Scoping:** rows are invisible across workspaces, and rows made outside a workspace go to the Default.
- **HTTP (`real_auth`):**
  - the API needs a session;
  - the role decides what a user can call;
  - cross-site writes are refused;
  - the admin portal flow works;
  - the Vite dev proxy origin counts as same-site even with a CORS wildcard (X-Forwarded-Host);
  - the policy endpoint is the server's rule table;
  - the chat role can talk to agents but not design them.

## Fixtures, mocks and external dependencies
- **`auth_db`:** a fresh auth database, with Mistral key checks stubbed to "accept" (`mistral_keys.KeyCheck`).
- **`scoped_workflows`:** the workflow engine on a temporary database with workspace scoping on.
- **`http`:** a FastAPI `TestClient(app.main.app)`.
- **Markers:** `real_auth`, so the real middleware runs, and `parametrize`.

## How to run
`python -m pytest tests/test_auth.py -q`.

## Known gaps and flakiness
- **Key validation against Mistral is stubbed.**
- **Rate-limit and lockout timing** depend on the settings and the in-process clock.
